name: Exterior Siding Repaint Protection & Setup
intent: Ground protection, fixture masking, HVAC covers, vehicle protection (spray), RRP containment (lead). Equipment setup.
doctrine: RP siding protection includes landscape edge (LF for brush jobs) and full landscape (SF for spray). HVAC units and vehicles need covering for spray. Equipment setup: spray 12 min, brush/roll 5 min. Scaffold deferred.
